steps.text: You are an assistant for a tutoring centre.
Hi, I'm Grace Okafor. I'd like maths tutoring for my son Daniel, who is in Year 9. Wednesdays after school would suit us.
Hello Grace. Daniel can join the Year 9 maths group on Wednesdays at 4 PM with Mr. Hughes. Each session is 60 minutes and costs $30.
Could he do 8 sessions to start?
Yes. 8 sessions at $30 each come to $240, starting on Wednesday 3 April.
Hmm, Daniel has football on Wednesdays now. Thursdays would work better.
Year 9 maths, Thursday group: 5 PM, tutor Ms. Patel, $30 per session, next start 4 April.
steps.output: Year 9 maths, Thursday group: 5 PM, tutor Ms. Patel, $30 per session, next start 4 April.

steps.text: The Thursday group meets at 5 PM with Ms. Patel, starting on 4 April. The price stays at $30 per session, so 8 sessions are still $240.
5 PM is a bit late. Is there anything earlier?
Sorry, 5 PM is the only Thursday slot.
Fine, we'll take it. Actually, make it 10 sessions so he is ready for his exams.
10 sessions at $30 come to $300. I will send the invoice by email.
Thanks. Invoice INV-3307 for $300 goes to grace.okafor@example.com. One correction: Thursday sessions are 45 minutes long, not 60 minutes.
That's fine. Is the price the same?
Yes, it is still $30 per session.
